summary: One church, bilingual. Weekend Masses Sat 7 PM, Sun 10 AM and 11:30 AM agree in both bulletins and the website; Tue-Fri 7 PM weekday Masses rest on both weeks' intentions and the website's standing schedule, with Monday 7 PM added for the Gregorian Masses Nov 2-Dec 1. Adoration (continuous exposition Sun 1:30 PM-Tue 6 PM, Wed 8-6, Thu 8 AM-Sat 6 PM) is printed only in the newest issue. No open questions.
